Finding student housing should take days, not months.
RentEase was built to bring the whole student accommodation process online, for students and landlords.

Every February, thousands of students arrive in unfamiliar cities with an acceptance letter and nowhere to sleep. Listings were scattered across noticeboards, WhatsApp groups and classified sites with no verification, no reviews and no recourse.

We built RentEase to bring that entire process online: verified landlords, honest photographs, transparent pricing, digital applications with supporting documents, and a proper record of every payment and maintenance request.
Landlords gained just as much. Instead of chasing paperwork, they now manage rooms, approvals, tenants and revenue in one dashboard.
Every landlord is vetted and every property is inspected against a student safety checklist before publication.
Real photos, real prices, real reviews. No hidden fees, no bait listings, no surprises on move-in day.
Students never pay platform fees. Landlords get tooling that makes compliance and occupancy easy.
Student representatives review every major release so the app keeps working for the people who use it.
A clear path from first search to signed lease.
RentEase handles discovery, documents, approvals, payments and maintenance so nothing gets lost in a WhatsApp thread.
Verify your student number, university, faculty and year of study once, then apply anywhere in seconds.
Filter by price, distance from campus, amenities and availability. Save favourites and compare side by side.

Submit your business details and proof of ownership. Our compliance team reviews genuine landlords.

Review student applications with attached documents, approve or decline, and assign the right room.
See income, occupancy and tenant records in your dashboard.
One platform for the entire accommodation lifecycle.
From the first search to the final month\'s rent, RentEase replaces spreadsheets, printed forms and scattered chats.
Every listing is checked before it goes live, with a verified badge on approved properties.
Applications, supporting documents, lease periods and approvals handled end to end without paperwork.
Deposits and monthly rent are recorded with a payment history you can review at any time.

Still stuck? Our support team replies to every message within one business day.
Yes. Students never pay a platform fee. Searching, comparing, booking, messaging and managing your lease is free; you only pay your landlord\'s rent and deposit.
How are landlords and properties verified?
Landlords submit identity and proof of ownership documents. Our team checks them before the property is published with a verified badge.
What documents do I need to book?
A copy of your ID or passport and proof of registration from your university.
You can cancel a pending booking before the landlord approves it. After approval, cancellation follows the landlord\'s policy.
Deposits and monthly rent are recorded in the app. Every payment appears in your payment history with a reference.
Log a maintenance request with photos from your dashboard. Your landlord is notified and you can track the status until it is resolved.
Can landlords list more than one property?
Yes. Each property has its own rooms, pricing, availability and tenants.
Whether you\'re a student with a booking question or a landlord ready to list, we\'re here.
Monday to Friday, 08:00 - 17:00 SAST. Urgent maintenance escalations are monitored seven days a week.
